OUR STORY


Viburnum Home takes its name from the viburnum flower which carries the meanings of purity and calmness, a sensibility reflected in our design aesthetic which evokes a welcoming feeling with an elevated simplicity.

Our team of talented designers draw upon pure forms that feature lush faux botanicals and verdant preserved moss, creating stunning arrangements to enhance your home. Our collection of home decor, ranging from candles and baskets to vases and trays, is thoughtfully curated so that you can add that finishing touch to your space with elegance and ease.

With over a decade of retail experience in the fresh flower and home decor industries, we fully understand the importance of quality of product, attention to detail, and value of the customer experience. We bring this knowledge and our passion to our latest venture, Viburnum Home, an online shop where the same level of beautiful products are available to ship throughout the United States. We invite you to bring Viburnum style into your home.
"Offering Products That Make Each House Feel Like A Beautifully Designed Home"
